description: SRD §7 re-score of the inconclusive iteration-4 G2 (experiments/20261024-i4-g2): the same five frozen models (experiments/20261023-i4a-val/models, bound by weights digests in experiments/20261024-i4-rescore-decision/decision.json), scored once on the test split of fresh seed 206 at 100,000 scenarios (indices 900,000-999,999 of a 1,000,000-scenario dataset, generated alone), with seed 205 training data for the normalisation. The full G2 verdict on this split alone decides; inconclusive counts as fail; not pooled with seed 205; held-out not re-scored; the iteration-3 models beside, reported only.
